lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 12 distinct vertical white lines. Spacing is irregular, with wider gaps on the anterior torso and progressively narrower, more frequent spacing towards the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the upper-mid posterior flank where a single vertical line splits into two distinct segments toward the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Significant line fragmentation on the posterior haunch where vertical lines break into series of 3-4 distinct spots before reaching the ventral margin.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A dense cluster of 4-5 high-contrast white spots is located on the lower haunch near the junction of the torso and the hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the mid-thigh align horizontally to form a short, semi-connected geometric line segment.

other_distinctive_markers: Broad white horizontal bands are visible on the mid-carpus of the forelimb and the mid-tarsus of the hindlimb. White facial markings consist of two distinct spots on the lateral snout and a white fringe on the interior pinnae.
